{{Quote|Do you know where [Ghez Hokan] is?''"<br />"''They're down at the farm the Kirmay clan used to own before Hokan sold them to Trandoshans. About fifty, maybe sixty of them. What are you going to do to us?|[[Darman Skirata|RC-1336]] and a Qiiluran villager|<ref name="RC:HC" />}}
The '''Kirmay clan''' was a group of individuals who owned a [[Kirmay clan's farm|farm]] near the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Imbraani]] on the<ref name="RC:HC" /> [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Qiilura system/Legends|Qiilura system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Qiilura/Legends|Qiilura]]<ref name="RC:HC" /> by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]'', which includes the mention of the Kirmay clan, in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> The clan lost the property when [[Ghez Hokan]], a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] serving in the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], [[Slavery/Legends|sold]] the group to [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slaver/Legends|enslavers]]. The farm was later repurposed as a staging area for fifty to sixty of Hokan's [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], as estimated by a [[Qiiluran]] [[Unidentified villager (Qiilura)|villager]].<ref name="RC:HC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kirmay clan was mentioned in the [[2004]] novel ''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact|Hard Contact]]'', the first novel in the ''[[Republic Commando]]'' series written by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="RC:HC" />
